svg.title: RuVector: search meaning, remember context, connect knowledge, learn from feedback
svg.desc: 20 second illustrative capability trailer. Local semantic embeddings and vector retrieval; persistent agent memory; graph relationships; learning from recorded outcomes and explicit feedback. Rust native. No live metrics.

g.text: Local embeddings turn text into searchable context.
Retrieve related vectors where your agents work.
Persist useful knowledge across agent sessions.
Combine vector retrieval with graph context.
Learning needs explicit feedback, not reads alone.
